title: The schedule
vo: So the schedule is: mix on day one, feed on day two, and keep 50 grams and feed on day three. On day four, switch to white flour and feed twice a day. By about day seven it doubles within 4 to 6 hours, and it's ready to bake with.
voUS: So the schedule is: mix on day one, feed on day two, and keep three and a half tablespoons and feed on day three. On day four, switch to white flour and feed twice a day. By about day seven it doubles within 4 to 6 hours, and it's ready to bake with.
cap: Mix on day 1, feed on day 2, keep 50 g and feed on day 3.
White flour twice a day from day 4. Ready at about day 7.
capUS: Mix on day 1, feed on day 2, keep 3½ tbsp and feed on day 3.
White flour twice a day from day 4. Ready at about day 7.
